description: Structured JSON report of one user's identity relationships — no UI needed, works headless. Dimensions: org (full manager chain to the root + direct reports), groups (direct memberships with group type — Security / Microsoft 365 / Distribution list / Mail-enabled security — and assigned vs dynamic membership), roles (directory roles), applications (app assignments), attributes (core profile values), or all (default). Use when the user wants analysis, a summary or the underlying data — after exploring the polyarchy visually, or instead of opening it. With no person argument it reports on the signed-in user (delegated modes only). Ambiguous names return candidates — re-call with userId.
name: polyarchy-report
title: Identity relationship report
